description: Have QualiLoop write and save tests from one prompt, grounded in what it knows about the agent: the main way to get tests, rather than writing them with create_test. It plans how many tests of which mode and category (up to 300 tests per prompt), writes them, checks them and saves them, in a minute or a few. Returns a generation id; call get_generation until finished is true, then run the saved tests with run_tests or the suite with run_suite. Uses an LLM and counts against a daily limit; generate what the user asked for.
